item.title: Teacher killed in auto-pedestrian accident
item.description: PRICE — Just after 7 p.m. on Dec. 17, 2025, a vehicle hit a pedestrian that was crossing the street on a crosswalk located at 500 N 300 E in Price. The pedestrian later died in Castleview Hospital. The pedestrian was Linda Garvin, a 64-year-old female who was a fourth grade teacher at Castle Heights Elementary School.
